data.desc: TransAct Technologies Incorporated is a global leader in developing and selling software-driven technology and printing solutions for high-growth markets, including foodservice technology and casino and gaming. The company's solutions are designed from the ground up based on customer requirements and are sold under the BOHA!, AccuDate, EPICENTRAL and EPIC brands. TransAct has sold millions of printers and terminals around the world and is committed to providing world-class service, spare parts and accessories to support its installed product base.
